$comment: ARD source catalog — ~100 authoritative public data sources as OKF-style descriptors. Fields: id, title, description, publisher, domain, entityType, relational (captures entity->entity edges), access {auth, kind, endpoint, capability}, trust, representativeQueries. Endpoints are indicative and should be re-verified before wiring. capability classes: point | entity-list | predicate-search | population-scan | server-aggregate | bulk | graph.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR — company filings & XBRL financials
sources.description: Financial statements and disclosures for US public companies, keyed by CIK.

sources.title: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets (BigQuery)
sources.description: Bulk XBRL financials across all filers, queryable as SQL for population rankings.

sources.title: SEC Forms 3/4/5 — insider ownership & trades
sources.description: Officers, directors and 10%-owners of public companies and their transactions (relational).
sources.entityType: insiders and the companies they are insiders of
representativeQueries: companies where this person is a director

sources.title: SEC 13F — institutional holdings
sources.description: Quarterly holdings reported by institutional investment managers (investor -> holds -> security).
sources.entityType: institutional managers and the securities they hold
